finding_groups.title: JCM977 stock Water is asserted as literal source input
finding_groups.proposed_bounded_fix: Remove Water from literal transcription or explicitly represent and evidence the aqueous-solvent inference using method CURATED_INTERPRETATION and truthful curator/LLM attribution. Preserve unknown solvent detail, stock volume and glucose form; basal790mL water is not stock water.
finding_groups.normalization_rationale: This unqualified positive stock-solvent claim is distinct from the acknowledged inferences in W06-IR-005. CURATOR_JUDGMENT is an evidence type, not the component assertion method. No claim that water is chemically false.

observation.title: Glucose stock solvent inferred but represented as literal recipe input
observation.description: B977 positively asserts aqueous stock and Water as a verbatim RECIPE_TRANSCRIPTION input, although JCM977 only names 20% w/v glucose; 790 ml distilled water belongs to the basal medium. C10% and A1M prose disclose a water inference but their structured assertion still treats the component set as recipe transcription. UNKNOWN closure does not establish a positive solvent identity.
observation.bounded_fix: For B977, remove unsupported Water from literal transcription and preserve solvent as unknown, or separately document a bounded CURATOR_JUDGMENT inference without claiming the primary states it. For C10%/A1M, clarify the mixed inference/transcription provenance rather than silently promoting inferred solvent to source fact. Retain concentration, unknown form and volume, and independent preparation instructions.
observation.reproduction: Compare exact payload components, component_assertion and notes with cited JCM raw captures. JCM977 contains no stock preparation entry identifying solvent; do not move basal-water quantity into the stock.
